trust_decision.summary: ADVISORY/FIX MISMATCH. The advisory describes SQL injection in Utils.buildCalcField, which pastes calc-param values from paramMap into SQL text with no validation (core/core-backend/src/main/java/io/dataease/engine/utils/Utils.java:102-107). The listed fix commit never touches Utils.java. It changes something else: whether a share-link JWT (X-DE-LINK-TOKEN) is trusted. At the pinned commit that token is only decoded, never signature-verified, in DeLinkAop, ShareVisitorPermissionManage and ChartViewManege. The fix moves the decision into a verified LinkIdentity (V3UserUtil.getLink) plus an endpoint/field/chart scope check.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names Utils.buildCalcField. A reader of the summary would go straight to the paramMap replaceAll at line 105, which the published fix never changes.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP request carrying a link token (Spring MVC HandlerInterceptor)
share-visitor operations that call require(...), e.g. ChartDataServer.innerExportDetails (ChartDataServer.java:260)
share proxy/validate HTTP API that issues the link token (callers at XpackShareManage.java:348,394)
internal static utility called from XpackShareManage.generateLinkToken
LinkTokenVerifier implementation used by the external AuthFilter/TokenUtils
de-xpack submodule bump (not present in pinned tree)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: fix.diff:1036-1042 (de-xpack submodule) and the external license SDK (V3UserUtil/TokenUtils are not in this repo, fix.diff:955-957). Both are needed for the fix to compile.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the advisory's SQLi a solver would never touch share-token auth. For the auth fix, ChartViewManege.checkLinkChart looks like a chart-business helper rather than an auth component, and the fix's README says business services were not modified (fix.diff:981).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Sub-canvas mode: a share token bound to a parent canvas must still reach embedded child canvases (subResource). Normal logged-in requests without a link token must stay unaffected.

O6_input_shapes: resourceTable != core or source == main-edit request beans
ChartExcelRequest whose viewId differs from viewInfo.id

O7_producer.where: core/core-backend/src/main/java/io/dataease/share/manage/ShareSecretManage.java:58-90 (it silently regenerated the signing secret on read/persist failure)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: checkLinkChart decodes the link JWT without verification and trusts its resourceId claim; the fix does not change this file
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It sits in a chart business manager, and the fix README states business services were left unchanged; the new DeLinkAop checkChart arguably supersedes it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: innerExportDetails branches on whether a link-token header is present, not on a verified identity
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is guarded by @DeLinkPermit plus require(EXPORT_DATA), so the header check looks like mode selection only

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the advisory's actual SQLi sink: calc-param values replaced into SQL with no validateSqlInjectionRisk/transValue
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same file already validates values for group fields (Utils.java:582-583,601-602), so a maintainer adding param support could easily have forgotten it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: one of 8 trans/* builders that merge chart-supplied params (mergeParam) before calcFieldRegex
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Each builder repeats the same mergeParam/calcFieldRegex pattern, so a per-builder check would be a natural omission.

O9_family: auth/authorization (unverified JWT, CWE-287/CWE-639) in the fix; SQL injection (CWE-89) in the advisory text

O10_build.project_tests: None at the pinned commit for this area. The fix adds a standalone runner, LinkTokenSecurityRegression, that needs a sibling dataease-license-sdk checkout and the bumped de-xpack submodule (fix.diff:955-957, fix.diff:1005-1011).

j.j_sites_touched: share/interceptor/DeLinkAop.java, share/interceptor/LinkInterceptor.java, share/interceptor/ShareQueryScopeAop.java (new), share/manage/LinkTokenValidationManage.java (new), share/manage/ShareSecretManage.java, share/manage/ShareVisitorPermissionManage.java, share/manage/XpackShareManage.java, share/util/LinkTokenUtil.java, de-xpack submodule
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: For the advisory as written, add validateSqlInjectionRisk to paramMap values in buildCalcField. That fix is unrelated to the published commit, so hidden tests built from it would fail it.

out_of_scope_notes: The advisory's real SQLi sink (Utils.java:105, paramMap replaceAll) is unfixed by the listed commit; the correct fix commit for CVE-2026-108824 is likely a different one.
The candidate field c_same_check_name=getLink refers to V3UserUtil.getLink, which does not exist at the pinned commit (it comes with the external SDK/de-xpack bump).

Whether AuthFilter (external SDK) already verifies link tokens at the pinned commit: unknown, the source is not in the repo.
